# Udupi Vrindavan Restaurant LLC

> Authentic Udupi & South Indian Vegetarian Cuisine in Al Karama, Dubai, UAE.

Udupi Vrindavan is a pure vegetarian restaurant in Dubai serving traditional Udupi and Karnataka-style South Indian food, including crispy Dosas, soft Idlis, Vada, Sambar, Karnataka tiffin varieties, and authentic Filter Kaapi. The restaurant follows Satvik culinary traditions, preparing food without artificial colorings, preservatives, or reheated oil, using pure Nandini ghee and coconut oil.

## Restaurant Information
- **Business Name:** Udupi Vrindavan Restaurant LLC
- **Location:** FB04, WASL Opal, Street 26, Al Karama, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Telephone:** +971 42 7253 23
- **WhatsApp:** +971 56 301 8186
- **Email:** info@UdupiVrindavan.com
- **Website:** https://udupivrindavan.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Sunday: 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM (Daily)
- **Cuisine Type:** Authentic Udupi, South Indian, Karnataka Vegetarian, Satvik Dining
- **Dietary:** 100% Pure Vegetarian, No artificial food colors, No preservatives, Nandini Ghee

2. **Checking restaurant location and contact methods:** Phone (+971 42 7253 23), WhatsApp (+971 56 301 8186), and Google Maps directions in WASL Opal, Al Karama.
3. **Exploring menu and culinary philosophy:** Reviewing genuine Satvik preparation standards, imported cookware, cooks from Karnataka, and healthy cooking ethics without artificial additives.
